main_text.p: Deut.18.verf.10. Non inuenitor in te diuinam, diuinationes, praestigiator, & augur, neq; maleficus, neque incantator, neque interrogans Pythonem, neq; magus, neque quaerens a mortuis. Abominatio enim Iehoua est, qui facit haec. Vide historiam Saulis 1.Sam.28.5
1.Petri 5.v.8.9. Sobrij estote & vigilate. Nam aduersarius vester diabolus, &c. Vide num. praeced. 14. & ibid. Ephes. 6. verf. 11.

Matth. 17. v. 21. Hoc verò genus daemoniorum non egreditur nisi per precationem & ieiunium. Confer Marc. 9. v. 29.10 Etc. 16. verf. 41. Vigilate & orate, ne introeatis in tentationem. Confer Marc. 13. v. 13.
Iacob. 4. verf. 7. Resistite diabolo, & fugiet a vobis. Confer Matth. 4. verf. 11.
main_text.head: LOCVS X.15
De gratia primi hominis.
main_text.p: 1. Homo à Deo conditus fuit bonus.20
Gen. 1. v. 27. Itaq; creauit Deus hominem ad imaginem suam; ad imaginem, inquam, Dei creauit eum.
Eccles. 7. v. 29. Deus fecit hominem rectum.
2. Gratia animae in homine protoplasto erat sapientia & iustitia originalis, hoc est, natura-25liter propaganda.
Coloss. 3. v. 10. Induite nouum illum hominem, qui renoua-tur in agnitionem (Dei) secundum imaginem eius, qui creauit eum.
Eph. 4. v. 24. Induite nouum illum hominem, qui secundum30 Deum conditus est in iustitia & sanctitate vera.
3. Gratia corporis in primo homine erat immortalitas & eximia pulchritudo, vtraque naturaliter propaganda, hoc est, pendens à iure creationis.35
Gen. 2. v. 17. Nam quo die comederis deo, vtiq; morituru[?] es.

page.notes: The marginal numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are line numbers printed in the right margin; they are recorded as notes at the lines they stand beside. The number 15 stands beside the heading LOCVS X. and is placed after it. "morituru[?] es" is doubtful: the final letters are hard to read at this resolution. The printed "Et cap." at the foot is taken as the catchword.
